pass_rule: required_any is satisfied and forbidden_any is absent
explicitly_not: whether the draft agrees with the user question
whether the model believes the draft

claim_id.semantic_triple_matching: diagnostic only; not an acceptance gate

contract_gate.strict_contract_pass: structural + strict schema + full triple + claim_id_allowed

notes: The allowlist is rendered into the prompt for future runs; it is not inferred from holdout gold.
Historical scores produced without the allowlist remain comparable only under the old strict schema label.
Alias polarities are accepted by the offline adjudicator for diagnosis, never by the strict gate.
